content: You own apps/mobile/src/i18n/en.json and apps/mobile/src/i18n/so.json exclusively. Please work now: read both files, then ADD these key groups (keep all existing keys): markets (shopChina, deliverTo, searchProductsPlaceholder, continueShopping, browseMarketplaces, shopByCategory, savedProducts, collections, wholesale, retail, smallCommodities, readyStock, loginRequired, translationSupported), browser (shoppingThroughChinaSuuq, translateToEnglish, translateToSomali, showOriginal, reviewProduct, readingProductDetails, addToCart, signInToMarketplace, openProductToBuy, sourceDetails, help, onboardingTip, dismiss), reviewSheet (productIdentity, variants, quantityAndMoq, minimumOrder, packSize, orderIncrement, mixedVariants, priceTier, goodsSubtotal, domesticDelivery, serviceFee, internationalShipping, duties, amountPayableNow, remainingToConfirm, askSmallerQuantity, moqNeedsConfirmation, detailsExtracted, yourConfirmationRequired, supplierConfirmationNeeded), moq (pieces, cartons, perCarton, totalPieces, minimumNotMet, minimumOrderMet), general (loading, error, retry, cancel, confirm, save, continueBrowsing, requestSourcing). Both files must have matching structures. Use natural Somali commercial terms — e.g. 'Jumlo' for wholesale, 'Ugu yaraan' for minimum, 'Gabiga' for carton.

You now own task t3: Redesign the marketplace browser at apps/mobile/app/marketplace/[marketplace].tsx (attempt 2, fresh start — the previous agent ran out of context before writing anything, so the file is still the original 909-line version).

Redesign requirements:
1. COMPACT HEADER: Back button, marketplace name + icon, search icon, saved-items icon, cart count. Optional subtitle 'Shopping through ChinaSuuq' (t('browser.shoppingThroughChinaSuuq')).
2. REMOVE the persistent URL bar and the floating controls toggle — put source URL + 'Open externally' in an overflow menu (••• button).
3. LANGUAGE CONTROL: one compact dropdown labeled 'Translate to English ▾' (t('browser.translateToEnglish')) with 3 options: English / Somali / Original (browser.translateToEnglish, browser.translateToSomali, browser.showOriginal). Keep the existing TRANSLATE_SCRIPT injection and AsyncStorage TL_KEY logic.
4. CONTEXT-AWARE BOTTOM BAR (the most important change) — compute pageState from signals you already have (loginWall, blocked, currentListing, captureBusy, URL):
   - loginWall or blocked → primary button 'Sign in to marketplace' (browser.signInToMarketplace) opening externally + secondary 'Request sourcing' (common.requestSourcing). NEVER show Add to cart.
   - no listing captured (home/category/search pages) → slim hint bar 'Open a product to buy' (browser.openProductToBuy) with no purchase button.
   - captureBusy → disabled bar 'Reading product details…' (browser.readingProductDetails).
   - currentListing with price > 0 → primary 'Review product' (browser.reviewProduct) → opens the capture form (SmartProductForm or ProductReviewSheet if available).
   - Keep the curated-products overlay fallback exactly as it works today.
5. WHATSAPP: remove the large WhatsApp button from the action bar. Put WhatsApp inside the overflow menu as 'Help' (browser.help) using the existing whatsappOrderLink util.
6. ONE-TIME TIP: on first browser visit show a small dismissable banner with t('browser.onboardingTip'), stored in AsyncStorage key 'chinasuuq-browser-tip-dismissed'. Never show again after dismissal.
7. KEEP all existing functionality: script injection (runPerPageScripts), onMessage handling, blocked schemes list, cookie injection, skeleton loading, login wall banner logic, curated products.
8. Use COLORS/SPACING/RADIUS/FONTS from @/lib/theme. i18n keys already exist in en.json/so.json under browser.*, common.*, markets.* — use the t() function from useI18n() (import { useI18n } from '@/lib/i18n').
9. Safe areas: bottom bar must respect insets; touch targets 44pt+.

Verify with: npx tsc --noEmit --project apps/mobile/tsconfig.json (ignore errors in ProductReviewSheet.tsx — another agent owns that file and is still writing it).

Do NOT touch: ProductReviewSheet.tsx, moq.ts, SmartProductForm.tsx, markets.tsx, i18n files — they belong to other agents.
